address.label: XYZ Apartments, Kondapur
address.formal_address: 12-3-45, XYZ Apartments, Kondapur Main Road, Hyderabad - 500084

landmark.name: Apollo Pharmacy
landmark.disambiguation_note: Not the Apollo Pharmacy near the metro station — this one is on the main road.

distinguishing_features: XYZ Apartments signboard above the entrance

approach_from.direction_label: Coming from the main road / Botanical Garden side
approach_from.instructions: Pass Apollo Pharmacy, take the second left. The building is on your right after 100 meters.
Take the service road exit, go straight for two blocks. The building is on the left, opposite a small park.

entrance_details.identifying_marks: XYZ Apartments sign above the entrance
entrance_details.access_notes: Security allows delivery drivers in without calling up

units.in_building_directions: Take the lift to the 3rd floor, it's the 2nd door on the left. No nameplate — look for the door with a black gate.

trigger_conditions: Driver still can't locate the building after being guided through both approach directions
Driver reports Apollo Pharmacy is no longer recognizable/visible
